description: Base graph node: the producer-authored part of a node, and the only part a producer may extend. The gear-assigned envelope -- tenant, timestamps, acting subjects, soft-delete tombstone and graph revision -- is not in this type: it is described by the API schema, because it has no meaning for an instance registered statically in the types-registry and because a producer can neither supply nor extend it.

scope_managed.description: Whether rows of this type participate in producer-scoped replacement re-sync.

emit_events.description: Whether CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE events are published for this type.

index.description: Payload paths backed by a JSONB index and admissible in $filter.

full_text_search.description: Paths composed into the node tsvector.

vector_search.description: Paths composed into the embedding input.

node_key.description: Producer-supplied stable key, unique per tenant -- the same value the node_key column stores and the ingest DTO carries. Producer-authored: it is how a producer addresses the same node on a later re-sync and how an edge names an endpoint whose node has not been ingested yet. It is a domain key, not a GTS instance identifier and not a gear-generated id; the gear's own row id and the API envelope are elsewhere.

payload.description: Typed attributes; derived types refine this member.

content.description: Long-form text; chunked and indexed, bounded by content_max_bytes.
